notes: The brand set for the CUSTOM-LANE TYPE SWEEP: the four shipped synthetic brands (benchmarks/pro/v1/spike/brands.json - kept verbatim, marks referenced across) plus TWO NEW invented organisations (owner ask 2026-08-17: 'more unique designs' - fresh briefs AND fresh brands). Pulse Arena is a two-ink full-colour mark (the knock rule must wait for a well); Boreal is a single DARK ink (a dark panel forces the knock). All marks are measured at run time by probeMark, never hand-written here. `assignment` fixes which brand conditions each brief of the 21-brief custom bank, so the round is reproducible from committed fixtures alone. No divergence cell in the iterate runner - do not add one (§21 fixture note).
